values.note: Two of the three campgrounds have individual water and electric hookups; the third is a walk-in tent area with centralized water. The park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/camping ('Two of the campgrounds provide individual water and electrical hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 86 standard water/electric sites in two campgrounds along Lake Russell, plus 14 walk-in tent sites (all but one waterfront). Some sites take RVs up to 40 ft, others up to 30 ft. One trailer/RV and one tent per site, two vehicles.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/camping ('Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 86 sites'; '14 walk-in tent sites'; 'Some of these sites accommodate RVs up to 40 feet, others up to 30 feet') + reservation policies on https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/campsites, read 2026-10-21

values.note: Wi-Fi only at the park office and the day-use beach, not in the campgrounds.

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; Laundry Facilities: Yes; Dump Station: Yes; 'Wi-Fi ... at the park office and the day-use beach area. It is not available in the campgrounds.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per the --AWH note, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/calhoun-falls/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night waiver from the entry's --AWH note

summary: Confirmed reservable on SC's own site with the 13-month window and 2-night minimum (now on the entry with the AWH phone waiver). Added water hookups (amperage not stated), 86 RV sites up to 40 ft, 14-night max, showers/laundry/dump, and Wi-Fi not in the campgrounds. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Not stated: amps, sewer, campground season, pull-throughs.
